messages:
nina: quick follow-up from the GPU postmortem. we have 5 action items: tenant burst cushion, scheduler hysteresis, nightly job gate, headroom reserve, and fallback telemetry. need owners + firm dates.

omar: i'll own scheduler hysteresis + replay measurements. plan: run baseline replay today, test coalesce=90ms and eviction_hysteresis=4%. results in 48h, PR in 10 business days.

celeste: i'll do tenant burst cushion (elastic-cushion 10% for 90s then decay). RFC + unit tests by 2026-04-06. also will add config flags for per-tenant overrides.

ravi: taking headroom reserve and telemetry. propose static reserve 4% + ephemeral surge 8%. will add fallback event_id to usage stream and billing flag. draft by 2026-03-30.

ops-bot: Created issue infra/ops#1702 "elastic-cushion + scheduler hysteresis" (assignee: celeste).

nina: two constraints: 1) fallback must not induce scheduler thrash, 2) nightly compaction at ~02:50 UTC needs gating.

omar: will add a randomized preflight delay for compaction when global headroom < 10% (1-5m). include in scheduler PR.

celeste: calendar: "GPU capacity follow-up" weekly 15m starting 2026-03-25 @ 10:00 PDT, rotating infra oncall. invite sent.

ravi: measurement targets: eviction_count down >=30% with p99 delta <10%. replay logs to infra/ops#1702. due 2026-03-28.

nina: i'll update the runbook and customer comms template once first PR lands. weekly triage for 6 weeks then reduce cadence if stable. ping here with PR links. :thumbsup:
